Welcome, Retreat Leader

Thank you for choosing Amansala as your retreat home. Leading a retreat is about more than just planning — it's about creating an experience, and we're honored to support you on this journey.

Use this dashboard to complete your room list, review your checklist, access our media folder, and find everything you need to run a seamless retreat.

Please provide your WhatsApp number so we can add you to the Amansala retreat coordinator group. This is our main channel for updates, logistics, and last-minute coordination.

Once your schedule has been submitted, our Activities Coordinator will review it and you will receive confirmation within a few days.

If any changes are needed, our team will contact you before final approval.

What's Included in Every Shala
All shalas are equipped with yoga mats, blocks, straps, meditation pillows, and blankets. We provide a lighter so you can light your own candles.
Optional add-on — Class Setup Service · $25 USD/day: Our team will lay out your mats, light candles and incense before each class. We simply ask that your students clean their own mats after class.
